title: Workshop
description: Settings for the guided workshop panel.

defaultWorkshop.title: Default workshop
defaultWorkshop.description: Directory of the workshop to open when JupyterLab starts and no workshop was open before, relative to the JupyterLab root directory. Leave empty to open nothing.

panelSide.title: Panel side
panelSide.description: Which sidebar the workshop panel starts in. Moving the panel by hand is remembered by JupyterLab's layout, and a workshop layout that names "instructions" for a side overrides this.

workshopsDirectory.title: Workshops directory
workshopsDirectory.description: Directory, relative to the JupyterLab root, into which downloaded workshops are placed.

defaultTrustLevel.title: Default trust level
defaultTrustLevel.description: Trust level selected by default in the trust dialog for workshops without a stored decision.

trustPolicy.title: Trust policy
trustPolicy.description: Administrator overrides, typically set through overrides.json.

forcedLevel.title: Forced trust level
forcedLevel.description: When set, every workshop opens at this level and the trust dialog is not shown.

trustedSources.title: Trusted sources
trustedSources.description: Source key prefixes that open as trusted without asking, such as "git:https://github.com/GrahamDumpleton/" or "local:examples/".

disabledCapabilities.title: Disabled capabilities
disabledCapabilities.description: Capabilities that never run regardless of the trust level.

registries.title: Workshop registries
registries.description: Registry index files listing workshops that can be installed: http(s) URLs, or paths relative to the JupyterLab root. The workshop browser shows every registry's workshops.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Administrator reporting of progress events, typically set through overrides.json. Events are always written to _workshop/events.jsonl in the workshop directory.

sink.title: Sink URL
sink.description: URL that receives every workshop's events as JSON lines by POST, without asking the learner. Leave empty to report only to sinks the learner opts in to.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Whether events carry the JupyterHub user name ("hub") or no identity ("none").
